decision: The complete three-file26-hunk wait adjustment retains302 static registrations,280 unchanged callbacks and22 changed callbacks. Whole callback comparison, including helper assertions and variable declaration kinds, accounts for28 changed wait durations: two CDK auto-scroll waits10 to100ms,25 drawer waits20 to100ms across19 callbacks, and one tooltip wait500 to600ms plus a new fixture.whenStable. The tooltip still observes absence after250ms and presence after finishing animation, but the later observation time and added stabilization are not scheduling or deadline equivalence. The comment-only dela correction is recorded separately. Decline these private wait widenings; retain owned legacy tooltip fakeAsync250/500ms observations, focus/overlay/form assertions and all existing source cases. Current public CDK/Material dependencies remain reachable: no drag/drop or drawer fork, absent-peer waiver, inherited runtime pass or weakened golden. No owned HTML/CSS/SCSS or template changes. Actual browser/native/packed, zoneful/zoneless and supported-floor gates remain open.
